description: Prospectively frozen expanded implementation census approved by user on 2026-10-25. Replaces aggregation wrappers with their actual implementation; shared camera/view runtime counted once.

counting_rules.denominator: 151 unique owned implementation units expanded from the frozen 152 translation-unit census. The shared refit_common/runtime.hpp implementation counts once for camera/view variants.
counting_rules.migrated: Count only units whose algorithms and workflow actually run in Rust, with superseded C++ algorithms removed, frozen/current comparison, linked artifact and integration evidence. Fine-grained Win32/COM/native ABI adapters may remain.
counting_rules.excluded: Pure aggregation/renaming wrappers, assembly, vendored MMM/FFmpeg, and unrelated headers do not receive migrated credit.
counting_rules.completion_limit: Unit coverage is not source volume, effort or total DLL completion; third-party replacement and in-game acceptance remain separate.
